title: No mention of custom GitHub agent repositories (#3861)
reality: v2.3.4 adds disabled-by-default custom GitHub agent repositories to the Agents Manager (#3861): a third-party agent-source path with manual preview/apply, explicit trust confirmation, stable sync identity, and bounded SSRF-safe archive validation. agents.md currently frames Download Agents as exclusively official.
fix: Add a '(2.3.4) Custom GitHub agent repositories' subsection under 'Downloadable Agents (v2.3)': custom repos are disabled by default, added in Agents Manager, require explicit trust confirmation, sync via a stable identity, updates are manual preview/apply, and archives get bounded SSRF-safe validation (#3861). Soften the 'official packages only' phrasing; the official catalog is the default and custom repos are an opt-in third-party path.

title: Export/import section predates #3953 hardening
reality: v2.3.4 (#3953) hardened agent transfer. Verified in packages/client/src/lib/agent-transfer.ts on main: sanitizeAgentSettingsForImport deletes enabledTools, createImportedAgentType mints a fresh type, countSkippedAgentImportFunctions skips bundled function entries. Exports no longer bundle function definitions.
fix: Update the 'Exporting & importing agents (v2.0)' section with the (2.3.4) restrictions: exports omit function definitions; imports never carry tool access or custom functions; imported agents land under a fresh custom type (cannot overwrite curated agents); tools must be explicitly re-attached (#3953).

title: Background agent still described as generating backgrounds
reality: v2.3.4 removed the Background agent's image-generation toggle and runtime path entirely. It now only selects existing library backgrounds; Illustrator owns both automatic and Gallery background generation.
fix: Edit the `background` entry: 'selects the scene background from the existing background library' with a (2.3.4) removal note; background generation belongs to Illustrator. Keep the v2.1 manual-pin note.

title: Illustrator entry missing Gallery Background routing (#3809)
reality: v2.3.4 routes the Roleplay Gallery's Background action through Illustrator's background prompt mode instead of a raw scene-generation prompt (#3809), and Gallery-generated backgrounds are applied to the active Roleplay chat rather than attached as ordinary illustrations.
fix: In the `illustrator` entry, add the (2.3.4) note about background-generation ownership and Gallery Background routing; cross-reference the slimmed-down `background` agent entry.

title: Source-of-truth cites removed agent-registry.generated.ts (#3847/#3848)
reality: Verified: packages/shared/src/features/agents/agent-registry.generated.ts now 404s on main. packages/shared/src/types/agent.ts survives with BUILT_IN_AGENT_IDS (21 legacy ids), RETIRED_BUILT_IN_AGENT_IDS, BuiltInAgentMeta (category/modeAllowlist/execution), and a runtime-populated BUILT_IN_AGENTS array filled from installed package manifests.
fix: In the 'Source of truth' paragraph, drop agent-registry.generated.ts / BUILT_IN_AGENT_MANIFESTS; note the (2.3.4, #3847/#3848) contract cleanup and cite types/agent.ts as the legacy-id source with BUILT_IN_AGENTS populated at runtime from installed package manifests.
